'''Ishi Shrine''' (also written 爲志神社, いしじんじゃ) is a shrine in {{ill|Katsuragi, Nara|ar|كاتسوراغي (نارا)|azb|کاتسوراقی، نارا|ca|Katsuragi (Nara)|ce|Кацураги (гӀала)|ceb|Katsuragi (lungsod sa Hapon)|de|Katsuragi|eo|Kacuragi (Nara)|es|Katsuragi (Nara)|fa|کاتسوراگی، نارا|fi|Katsuragi (Nara)|fr|Katsuragi|gl|Katsuragi, Nara|hy|Կացուրագի|id|Katsuragi, Nara|it|Katsuragi (Nara)|ja|葛城市|ko|가쓰라기시|mzn|کاتسوراگی، نارا|nl|Katsuragi (Nara)|pl|Katsuragi (Nara)|pt|Katsuragi (Nara)|ro|Katsuragi, Nara|ru|Кацураги (город)|sv|Katsuragi|tg|Катсураги|tl|Katsuragi, Nara|tr|Katsuragi|tt|Кацураги (шәһәр)|uk|Кацураґі (Нара)|ur|کاٹسوراگی، نارا|vi|Katsuragi, Nara|war|Katsuragi, Nara|zh|葛城市|zh_classical|葛城市|zh_min_nan|Katuragi-chhī|zh_yue|葛城|qid=Q659672}}, {{ill|Nara Prefecture|Q131287|qid=Q131287}}.

=== History ===
The founding date is unknown. The shrine is listed under {{ill|Yamato Province|Q907495|qid=Q907495}} {{ill|Oshimi district|ja|忍海郡|zh|忍海郡|qid=Q11490759}} in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}. Following government policy in the Meiji period, it was merged into {{ill|Katsuraki ni Imasu Honoikaduchi Shrine|ja|葛木坐火雷神社|qid=Q11620954}} and abolished in 1910 (Meiji 43). A stone monument titled "Ishi Shrine Ruins" was erected, and in 1982 (Shōwa 57) the shrine buildings were reconstructed and the shrine was revived.

=== Enshrined deity ===
The enshrined deity is Ikobitohei no Mikoto.
